mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, id_number_enc AS idNumberEnc, id_number_hash AS idNumberHash, birthday, household_address AS householdAddress, residence_address AS residenceAddress, emergency_contact AS emergencyContact, emergency_phone AS emergencyPhone, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM employee_personal WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_personal (employee_id, id_number_enc, id_number_hash, birthday, household_address, residence_address, emergency_contact, emergency_phone) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{idNumberEnc}, #{idNumberHash}, #{birthday}, #{householdAddress}, #{residenceAddress}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyPhone})
